Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q3 2022 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of TSLA.
Our gross margin expanded by 53 basis points to 51.9%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
While we remain optimistic, there can be no assurance that macroeconomic headwinds won't affect demand.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q3 2022.
Operating income reached $6.5 billion, demonstrating the operating leverage in our model.
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
Thank you for the question. We generated $6.9 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
Second question - Analyst:
Could you quantify the FX headwind embedded in your guidance?
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 53 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
